Module 02: Cataloguing & Metadata — Learning Objectives

By the end of this module, students will be able to:

  • Analyze the structural relationship between physical codicology (support, quires, watermarks, ruling) and digital metadata standards.
  • Query and integrate international manuscript authority files including Trismegistos (TM), Pinakes, and the Canonical Text Services (CTS) URN namespace.
  • Author and validate comprehensive TEI Header structures (<teiHeader>, <msDesc>, <physDesc>, <history>) compliant with the TEI P5 schema.
  • Evaluate the accuracy and hallucination risks of Large Language Models (LLMs) when generating structured archival metadata and implement deterministic validation audits.
